title: An indefinite later
vo: Dia bilang, nanti kita bahas. Lo jadi lebih tenang, atau malah bingung: nanti itu kapan?
purpose: Show an indefinite speech space between two people and a clock without an agreed marker.
beats: Two participants face the speech space
A later ribbon starts across the gap
The route stops at an empty clock
An unresolved marker remains

title: The return belongs in the plan
vo: Jeda bisa memberi ruang buat menenangkan diri. Obrolannya tetap perlu punya waktu kembali.
purpose: Give the value early: a pause and an agreed return are part of one plan.
beats: The existing route is visible
A pause opens space between actors
A shared time marker arrives
The return route completes

title: The changed plan
vo: Misalnya, kalian membahas rencana yang berubah. Nada mulai naik, dan jawaban makin pendek.
purpose: Establish a changed shared plan on a table as the illustrated argument begins.
beats: A table carries the original plan
A replacement card overlaps it
A speech ribbon rises
A short answer interrupts its length

title: The conversation remains
vo: Satu orang pergi. Yang lain masih duduk dengan pertanyaan yang belum selesai.
purpose: One participant moves away while the unfinished shared topic stays with the other.
beats: Both actors remain recognizable
One moves toward the edge of the conversation
The topic card stays on the table
The other actor and unresolved route hold

title: Two possible experiences
vo: Lo mungkin butuh tenang. Dia mungkin belum tahu apakah percakapan ini bakal dilanjutkan.
purpose: Show separate possible experiences without pretending to read motives.
beats: Both actors occupy separate spaces
One space opens for calming
The other retains the question
Both possibilities stay visible without a verdict

title: Suspend the verdict
vo: Satu jeda belum menjelaskan niat seseorang. Lihat juga cara jedanya dibicarakan.
purpose: Keep an open question beside the departing trace instead of attaching a verdict.
beats: A familiar departing trace is visible
An unanswered question opens
A verdict card stops short
Attention moves to the shared speech space

title: Agree while calm
vo: Saat suasana tenang, sepakati bagaimana kalian meminta jeda dan kembali ngobrol.
purpose: In a calm two-shot, both participants place a marker on a shared agreement.
beats: Two actors share a calm table
The pause signal enters
A time marker is offered
Both routes meet the agreement

title: State the need
vo: Ketika mulai kewalahan, bilang kondisi lo dan minta waktu, tanpa menyerang.
purpose: Focus on the requester naming their own state and opening room for a pause.
beats: Requester fills the focal field
A body-state ribbon contracts
A speech space opens outward
The other participant receives the request

title: A concrete return request
vo: Gua mulai susah dengar. Gua mau tenang dulu. Kita lanjut jam delapan, ya?
purpose: Let a proposed time travel from the requester toward a shared clock.
beats: A large shared clock anchors the frame
A request ribbon reaches it
The 20:00 proposal becomes visible
The other actor adds a reply marker

title: A workable appointment
vo: Jam delapan cuma contoh kesepakatan. Pilih waktu yang realistis buat kalian.
purpose: Give both participants room to choose a realistic appointment rather than a universal interval.
beats: A shared appointment page opens
One proposed slot is visible
Another person moves a token toward it
The two routes meet without claiming any fixed interval

title: A calming interval
vo: Selama jeda, lakukan hal yang menenangkan. Jangan sibuk menyusun balasan buat menyerang.
purpose: Use a window, plant and seated silhouette to make the cooling interval concrete.
beats: A participant sits beside a window
The conflict note is set aside
Space opens around the silhouette
A plant and cup settle into a quiet interval

title: Return in action
vo: Lalu, benar-benar kembali. Kesepakatan tadi perlu kelihatan dalam tindakan.
purpose: Bring the established participant back to the same unfinished topic.
beats: The original topic waits at the table
The returning actor moves toward it
The other actor turns toward the route
The shared route reconnects; quiet hold

title: Renegotiate explicitly
vo: Kalau belum siap, kabari dan sepakati ulang. Jangan membiarkan orang lain menebak.
purpose: An update travels before the appointment marker is moved by agreement.
beats: The original appointment remains visible
An update ribbon reaches the waiting participant
A new appointment marker is proposed
Both paths meet the revised marker

title: Resume the original issue
vo: Pas balik, mulai dari persoalan yang tadi tertunda. Nggak harus langsung beres semuanya.
purpose: Bring the original changed-plan card back to the shared table for discussion.
beats: The same topic card returns
Two actors sit at the shared table
A listening route opens
The card turns toward both; resolution stays open

title: Notice repeated postponement
vo: Kalau berulang kali nggak dilanjutkan, bicarakan pola penundaannya saat suasana lebih tenang.
purpose: Make repeated pending cards visible as a pattern that can itself be discussed.
beats: One pending card is visible
Two further pending cards accumulate
The pair turns attention to the stack
A shared speech space opens about the pattern

title: Complete the word later
vo: Jadi, kalau bilang nanti, coba lengkapi: kapan kita kembali, dan siapa yang mulai?
purpose: Complete the shared return path with time and initiation markers, then hold quietly.
beats: Two participants and their shared topic remain
A time marker joins the route
An initiation marker completes the path
Both actors settle with the plan; quiet final hold
